verses.1: Praise the LORD, O my soul.
verses.2: I will praise the LORD as long as I live; I will sing my praises to my God while I still draw breath.
verses.3: Do not put your trust in princes, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
verses.4: His spirit departs, he returns to his earth; on that day all his plans come to nothing.
verses.5: Happy is the one whose help is the LORD, whose hope is in the LORD his God.
verses.6: He who made the heavens and the earth, the sea and all that is in them—faithfulness is His covenant forever.
verses.7: He who brings justice to the oppressed, who gives bread to the hungry— the LORD releases the imprisoned.
verses.8: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous.
verses.9: The LORD watches over the strangers; He upholds the orphan and the widow, but He causes the path of the wicked to be destroyed.
verses.10: The LORD shall reign forever; your God, O Zion, from generation to generation—praise the LORD.

notes:
Notes  
- v. 10: "Zion" is used in the original as a poetic address to the people of God, and not as a literal city.
